sources.title: OpenMed — local-first clinical AI
sources.snippet: OpenMed 2.2.0 · on-device clinical AI Your data. Your model. Your iPhone. OpenMed reads clinical text and removes 55+ PHI types on the hardware you control, so patient data never leaves the device. 2,000+ Apache-2.0 models, 33 model-backed PII languages, state of the art on 10 of 12 biomedical NER benchmarks — and a new release most weeks.

sources.title: Meet OpenMed-PII-Portuguese: A Tiny Apache-2.0 Model for De-Identifying ...
sources.snippet: Meet OpenMed/OpenMed-PII-Portuguese-ClinicalE5-Small-33M-v1: a compact token-classification model that labels patient names, dates, locations, ID numbers and similar spans, so you can de-identify records before analysis or sharing. It's not a chatbot; it's a focused tool you can plug straight into a preprocessing pipeline.
